title: Nyrstar marks Port Pirie’s first shipment of Australian-produced Antimony metal
locator: Opening paragraphs and potential expansion paragraph
en: Issuer record of first demonstration-plant shipment. The 5,000 t/y figure is potential expanded capacity; shipment tonnage is undisclosed. Its unspecified “15% market” comparison is not adopted.

title: World Mineral Production 2020–24
org: British Geological Survey; N. E. Idoine et al.
locator: Printed p.5 antimony; p.74 tungsten; p.48 molybdenum exclusion
en: Official statistical compilation supporting Sb/W charts. Country estimates, rounded totals and reporting-period/proxy caveats are retained. These are not refining or revenue shares. See E24 for the excluded Mo comparison.

title: What are critical minerals
locator: Antimony, Bismuth, Tungsten entries and definition
en: Government technical overview for applications and classification. Supports Sb extraction, Bi byproduct recovery and W tooling uses; does not establish end-use shares or company rankings.

title: Metals and Alloys
locator: Product Overview and Features
en: Manufacturer catalogue linking In to ITO/InP, Ge to optics and Ga to GaAs/GaN. Establishes products and positioning, not independently measured market shares.

title: High-purity Gallium
locator: Purity table; Gallium Recycling Business
en: Direct product specifications for 6N/7N gallium and scrap recovery. Purity is not recovery, output or proof of qualification for every customer.

title: China — molybdenum and tungsten
locator: China operations description and product paragraph
en: Confirms Mo/W mining, processing, ferromolybdenum and APT activities. Positioning is not an independent ranking; no cross-year share is computed from its production figures.

title: 厦钨简介 — Xiamen Tungsten corporate introduction
locator: Corporate introduction main business paragraph
en: Confirms the mine-to-powder, carbide, tool and recycling chain. Other group activities include rare earths and battery materials; group revenue is not tungsten revenue.

title: Indium
locator: Product description below opening smelter paragraph
en: Confirms zinc-associated indium and high-purity indium production at Auby. No output, capacity or share is inferred.

title: Tolling
locator: Tolling body paragraph
en: Customer concentrate is converted into oxide or ferromolybdenum and returned, supporting the tolling example. Undated capacity claims are not used.

title: 5N Plus Inc. Reports Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results
locator: Financial Highlights; adjusted margin disclosure
en: Supports US$122.4m revenue, 28% growth and adjusted margin of 30.3% versus 34.6%. Non-IFRS group metric; not a single-metal or industry-average margin.

title: 5N Plus Inc. Scales Up and Expands Critical Materials Supply Agreement with First Solar
locator: Opening three paragraphs
en: Issuer contract announcement identifying CdTe and planned CdSe supply. No value or tonnage is disclosed; commitments do not establish delivered volumes or industry-wide demand.

title: Molymet completes acquisition process in the United States integrating Rhenium Alloys into the group
locator: Announcement body under headline
en: Supports the approximately US$40m acquisition and Mo/W/Re product extension. It does not prove future returns; self-reported processing-capacity shares are not used as independent market shares.

title: 2025 Sustainability Report
locator: Product Portfolio; Highlights of the Year
en: Confirms niobium products and applications. Ferroniobium-equivalent tonnes differ from contained-niobium tonnes; no mixed-basis calculation is made.

title: Full Year Results 2025
locator: Specialty Materials and footnote 1
en: Confirms germanium business and the revenue definition excluding specified purchased metals. Segment revenue is not all germanium revenue; unverified recycling percentages are omitted.

title: 商务部 海关总署公告2023年第23号 — Ga and Ge export controls
locator: Item lists; licensing; commencement
en: Historical item-based licensing notice. It is not alone an exhaustive current compliance list or evidence that all exports stopped.

title: 商务部 海关总署公告2024年第33号 — Antimony-related export controls
locator: Section I item list; II documents; VIII commencement
en: Supports specified Sb-related items and application documents. Some items have technical thresholds; licensing is not a universal embargo.

title: 商务部 海关总署公告2025年第10号 — W Te Bi Mo In related items
locator: Sections I–V and final operative paragraphs
en: Supports listed materials and technologies. Distinguishes specified indium compounds and Mo-powder conditions from all products containing those elements.

title: 商务部公告2025年第72号及2024年第46号 — Suspension and underlying US-specific provisions
locator: No72 operative paragraph; No46 clauses 1 and 2
en: Only clause 2 is suspended for the stated interval. Clause 1 and general licensing remain separate considerations. No post-expiry policy is forecast. The original No46 link follows.

title: Global Critical Minerals Outlook 2026 — Executive summary
locator: Byproduct smelters and technology/workforce paragraphs
en: Supports the role of smelters and technology/skills constraints. Broad critical-mineral aggregates are not all-minor-metal metrics; early-year price observations are not October spot prices.

title: Designing an effective strategic stockpiling system for critical minerals
org: IEA; Scanziani, Dhir, Nishiumi and Kim
locator: Strategic stocks section; risk and physical-form discussion
en: Supports byproduct responsiveness, usable stockpile forms and short-term buffering. Stocks do not replace diversification; purchase outlay differs from annual holding cost.

title: Gallium — Metal norms
locator: Quality, Form, Packaging and Lot Size
en: Illustrates specification, packaging and lot terms. It is not a 2026 price list or a universal semiconductor-customer specification.

title: Minor Metals Ready for the Circular Economy
locator: How do minor metals fit in to the Circular Economy
en: Supports the existence of In/W/Re recovery routes. Historical forecasts are not adopted; a route’s existence does not establish a 2026 recycling rate.

title: 商务部公告2026年第26号 — Reporting of strategic-mineral export-control violations
locator: Reportable conduct and commencement
en: Reporting and enforcement mechanism; does not itself establish a blanket product ban or a violation by any named business.

title: Molybdenum in December 2025
org: US Geological Survey; D. E. Polyak
locator: PDF p.3 Table 1; tonnes of contained Mo
en: Reports 2024 US concentrate output of 34,000 tonnes contained Mo versus 67,000 in E02. The discrepancy is unresolved; the Mo share chart is excluded rather than splicing sources.
